serviceDescription: YGI Solutions is a compliance and cybersecurity consulting firm serving organizations in highly regulated industries, including defense, aerospace, financial services, and healthcare. YGI helps cloud service providers prepare for, achieve, and maintain FedRAMP authorization through readiness assessments, program design, documentation, GRC platform implementation, and ongoing continuous monitoring support. YGI also supports adjacent federal and state frameworks, including CMMC, GovRAMP, CJIS, and NIST SP 800-171.

servicesOffered.serviceDescription: Gap analysis against FedRAMP requirements, remediation planning, and preparation for independent assessment by a FedRAMP-recognized assessor.
End-to-end support for FedRAMP authorization, including authorization boundary definition, control implementation guidance, and required documentation and machine-readable materials.
Ongoing assistance with FedRAMP continuous monitoring obligations, vulnerability and POA&M management, and significant change planning.
Fractional senior security leadership to own and run the security and compliance program for cloud service providers.
Outsourced governance, risk, and compliance team services to operate policies, evidence collection, and risk management.
Implementation and configuration of GRC automation platforms, including Vanta, to support FedRAMP evidence collection and reporting.
Selection and procurement of FedRAMP-appropriate security tooling and vendors to meet control requirements.
